pages.text: Also see $(l:example_setups/bucket_filler)Bucket Filler$(/l).$(br2)Note that since this uses a $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l), it is meant to integrate into your $(l:ae2_mechanics/autocrafting)autocrafting$(/l) setup.$(br2)Sometimes, life is inconvenient and you need the fluid itself but you can only make the fluid in a bucket. Sometimes a machine might do this for you (like the Fluid Transposer from Thermal Expansion), but you

might not always have a mod that does it conveniently for you. Luckily vanilla Minecraft has a slightly-less-convenient way, the $(item)Dispenser$().$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()

pages.title: Configurations
pages.text: $(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l) (1) is Set to lock crafting "With redstone signal" and blocking mode turned on, with the relevant $(l:items_blocks_machines/patterns)Processing Pattern$(/l)s.

pages.title: Charger Pattern
pages.text: $(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/interface)ME Interface$(/l) (2) is in its default configuration.

$(li)The first $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l) (3) is in its default configuration.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/annihilation_plane)ME Annihilation Plane$(/l) (4) has no GUI and cannot be configured.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/import_bus)ME Import Bus$(/l) (5) is filtered to buckets.$(li)The second $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l) (6) is in its default configuration.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: 1. The $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l) pushes the ingredients into the $(l:items_blocks_machines/interface)ME Interface$(/l). (Actually, as an optimization, it pushes directly through the storage bus asi fit was an extension of the provider's faces. The items never actually enter the interface.)$(br2)2. Through mechanisms described in $(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet#providing-to-multiple-places)pipe subnets$(/l), the bucket ends up in the $(item)Dispenser$().

3. The $(item)Comparator$() detects the bucket in the dispenser and thus simultaneously powers the dispenser and locks the $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l).$(br2)4. The dispenser dumps out the fluid from the bucket, it now has an empty bucket in itself.$(br2)5. The $(l:items_blocks_machines/import_bus)ME Import Bus$(/l) pulls the empty bucket out of the dispenser and stores it through the $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l) into the pattern provider, returning it to the main
network.$(br2)6. The comparator sees the dispenser is empty, unlocking the provider.
